title: Exclude the local build output from the lint script
objective: npm run lint (eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next) lints the ignored .sites-runtime/portable-build/.next output when a portable build exists locally, and reported 12 require()-import errors there at adoption on 2026-09-20. With that directory excluded the source itself still reports two no-explicit-any errors (app/api/admin/route.ts:14 and app/api/public/route.ts:7) and two unused-variable warnings, so lint is not configured in project.json until both halves are fixed: the script should ignore .sites-runtime, and the two any types should be replaced.
acceptance: package.json's lint script ignores .sites-runtime (or an eslint config ignores it) and npm run lint passes with a local portable build present.
The two no-explicit-any errors in app/api/admin/route.ts and app/api/public/route.ts are resolved without changing behaviour; the unused-variable warnings are cleaned or justified.
project.json's validation gains npm run lint once it passes here.
non_goals: No change to what the suites test.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Done on 2026-09-20: eslint.config.mjs ignores .sites-runtime/**; requireThat takes unknown; the public route's head row is typed; the two unused-variable warnings are left as warnings. npm run lint passes with the local build present and is now in every validation tier.

metrics.lesson: Lint ignores belong in the lint configuration, not in the command that calls it, so every caller means the same thing.
